description: Use when an agent needs an EVM wallet's holdings in one call. Input: address; chain (base default, ethereum, arbitrum); optional tokens (up to 20 ERC-20s; default: main stablecoins, WETH, BTC wrappers). Output: JSON block+time, ETH balance, per-token symbol, decimals, raw and decimal balance, nonce, isContract. Chain state only, no prices. Bad input: 400, not charged. Example: ?address=0x6246eee0355Dd7A93C888fE59e1151388A0cC5a1 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

address.description: Wallet or contract (0x + 40 hex; mixed case must be a valid EIP-55 checksum). Bad input → 400 (not charged)

tokens.description: Up to 20 comma-separated ERC-20 contract addresses on the chosen chain. Omit for the default set. A contract that is not an ERC-20 is listed with status not_an_erc20.

name: base_wallet_balances
title: Wallet balances on Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum: ETH + many ERC-20s in one call, with nonce and contract flag
